verdict.rationale: Dynamic Routing docs list 'restricting each user/project/team with budget/rate limits' as a use case and describe flows that 'enforce quotas', so per-user and per-team budget controls are claimed. However, they are only named in passing as a use case. The documented rate limiting is request-count based (e.g., 100 requests per 60 seconds) rather than a spend cap, and cost appears only as observability metrics. Missing for 10: documented mechanics for hard dollar/token spend caps, per-API-key budget limits, enforcement behavior when a budget is exhausted, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
